entityDescription:
The University of Santiago de Compostela (USC), founded in 1495, is one of the university institutions with the longest tradition in Europe. USC is situated among the top ten Spanish universities in regard to their positioning in the different international (ARWU, QS, SIR, Reuters, Nature Index, Webometrics) and national (U-ranking) university rankings.The education, research and social commitment of the USC has allowed to define a new institutional strategy based on specialization, scientific excellence and impact of results. As a result, two main projects (Campus Vida and Campus do Mar) have been awarded with the International Campus of Excellence recognition. In addition, two new projects (Campus Terra and Campus da Cidadanía) are being developed. This institutional strategy is addressed to contribute to the development of a new model of sustainable economic and social growth based on talent, innovation and internationalisation.
USC is organised into two campuses, in Santiago de Compostela and Lugo, which complement each other regarding the different specializations each of them offers (a total of 61 bachelor degrees, 68 master degrees and 55 doctoral programs). In terms of human resources, the university has more than 2,000 professional and research personnel (about 42% female) involved in education and research, over 26,000 students each year, and more than 1,000 people working in administration and services (about 8% supporting research activities).
Research and Technology Development is one of the most important activities in the USC having the infrastructure facilities and human resources needed for the training of young researchers. More than 250 research teams, belonging to the different Departments (50), Singular Research Centres (4) and Research Institutes (11), offer a high-quality scientific production in 6 strategic multidisciplinary areas (Biomedicine and Biotechnology; Physics; Environmental Technologies; Bio-economy, Territory and Entrepreneurship; Cultural Heritage and Land Resources) which are of main socioeconomic interest. This has allowed a narrow technological cooperation with regional, national and international institutions, companies and SMEs. R&D activities were supported with an average of €60 million/year (20% corresponding to contracts with private companies and 60% to competitive public funds) during the last 5 years.

entityDescription:
Founded in 2004, UBIMET GmbH is the largest private provider of meteorological services in Austria and among the top five largest weather companies in Europe. With the headquarter based in Vienna, UBIMET runs several affiliates in Melbourne, Munich, Karlsruhe, Zürich and New York. Currently, UBIMET has about 80 employees. 

The company's main area of expertise lies in the field of meteorology, specifically in developing forecast models, issuing weather forecasts and severe weather warnings with high temporal and spatial resolution, as well as in preparing data and forecasts tailored to suit individual customer requirements, such as information services, risk management, personnel planning, decision support etc. The clientele includes insurances, infrastructure operators, municipalities and individuals, as well as mass media, such as daily newspaper and private radio stations. 

UBIMET operates the Severe Weather Centre in Austria, Germany, Hungary, Poland, Czech Republic, Slovakia, Slovenia, Romania, Serbia and Montenegro, France and Australia. They provide private costumers, companies and communities with forecasts and warnings for storm, thunder storm, heavy rain and hail via email, fax and SMS. The success of UBIMET (with more than 2.5 Mio private costumers) is based on their models and systems they developed. 

Due to the essential advantage of an in-house research and development department UBIMET can provide state-of-the-art know-how in all areas of meteorological technology and has experience in different joint research programmes dealing with meteorology and ICT. UBIMET invests about 20% of its business volume in R&D. The major research focus is put on the improvement of meteorological nowcasting and forecasting models, assimilation of real-time data, dynamic receiver integration and information adaptation, situation-based event notification and information logistics. 
In the framework of different co-funded projects (national and EU FP7) UBIMET was able to determine the important aspects needed for accurate weather delivery. This includes a very high spatial resolution of 1 km and a very high temporal resolution of one hour for all meteorological parameters of the forecast models. 
Based on the severe weather warning requirements, UBIMET developed high technical knowledge in the fields of spatial modeling, GIS, stable and performant data flow, logistics and communications, as well as data overlays. UBIMET has access to worldwide national weather observation data. Additionally, real-time observation data, information from international computer models as well as satellite and weather radar data from all parts of the world are received and processed around the clock in the UBIMET Data Centers.
The processing of a large data volume and the calculation of forecast models requires high computing power. UBIMET has more than 30 servers, which are mostly hosted in data centers to ensure failure safety. Additionally, a WRF (Weather Research Forecast) computer cluster is at UBIMET's disposal. With its high operative capability, UBIMET has the ability to cover the entire demand for high-resolution weather analysis and forecasts for all of Europe.

entityDescription:
EnduroSat was founded in 2015 in Sofia, Bulgaria and has grown to be a high-end space infrastructure builder, which specializes in the development and production of state-of-the-art software defined satellites and related space services, bringing a paradigm improvement in payload data services accessibility and cost. The company is vertically integrated with in-house capability to design, engineer and build satellite modules, subsystems and entire satellite platforms.
EnduroSat designs and operates satellites up to 400 kg, providing businesses and researchers with space data which can be used for environmental monitoring, urban planning, and disaster management. Company’s comprehensive Space Service handles mission design, launch, and operations, delivering analysis-ready data on demand. Equipped with advanced onboard AI, EnduroSat’s satellites offer insights with reduced data latency and transmission volume.
EnduroSat satellites are software-flexible, with AI capability in orbit, significantly outmatching the current solutions. The systems are delivered at significantly lower cost without compromising on data accuracy and performance, providing the capability to support the most advanced applications for data processing. With 5-year lifetime, the missions follow an agile development approach allowing for rapid technology iterations and enhancements with each satellite generation. With flexible mission operations, the customers have direct control over the data quality, acquisition and delivery process at significantly shorter timeframes.
Developing next generation technology requires world-class equipment. Our current facilities are housed in 17 000 sq.m. Space center in Sofia, equipped with all the necessary infrastructure to carry out modern engineering activities such as a cutting-edge RF lab, anechoic chamber, TVAC, R&D studios, satellite assembly facility, warehouse storage, and mission control.
Our team includes more than 300+ talented engineers and experts in the space sector currently attending 450+ global customers.
